_note: Grade 3, the unit "Reading Long Words" (English literacy year, Part 12.3; types/_shared/long-words-g3.js; written by the scratch script x-g3long/bank.js from data-a.js and data-b.js). `co`: two-syllable words by level, each split into syllables with its syllable types (C closed, O open): level 1 two consonants between the vowels, level 2 an open first syllable, level 3 one consonant between the vowels (ro|bot or cam|el); `review`: level-1 words split again on level 2 (three or four a page, never offered in a sentence); sentences to choose a word from three, each naming the other words of its level that fit too (G3-512). `cosort`: the words each level of G3-513 sorts by the first syllable (closed or open), the words that fit neither (level 3), and yes-or-no sentences. `ty`: words by level with their syllables and types (C closed, O open, E silent e, V vowel team, L consonant-le): level 1 consonant-le words, level 2 consonant-le and silent-e words, level 3 three syllables; the pools of the sorts; the parts a word is built from (G3-515) and every pair of parts that makes a real word (`joins`); yes-or-no sentences. `suffix`: words with -ful, -less, -ness, -ment, -able: the base, the part of the word to circle (the base as it stands: happi, lov), the change (y to i, silent e dropped), the meaning, a sentence (G3-516); pairs of one base (G3-516 task 2); sentences with two words of one base (G3-517); `two`: the base carries a suffix of its own (friendly), never a word whose base is circled; `odd`: the meaning is not the meaning of the suffix (wonderful), never in a meaning task. `heart`: heart words with their sound boxes and the boxes learned by heart; sentences, each naming the other heart words that fit it too (G3-518). `ough`: words by the sound of ough, words of another ough sound (`other`: crossed out on level 3; `extra`: only in the sentences), yes-or-no sentences (G3-519).
